1. Press and hold the multi-function Power button on the right earcup for 4 seconds.
2. The LED indicator will alternately flash blue and red, accompanied by an audio chime "Pairing mode".
3. Open your mobile phone, computer, or audio player's Bluetooth menu.
4. Select "Lumina Wave ANC" from the list of discoverable devices.
5. Once connected, the LED indicator will blink blue once every 5 seconds, and a voice prompt will announce "Connected".

The dedicated "ANC" button is situated on the lower edge of the left earcup. Press the ANC button sequentially to toggle between three distinct listening modes:
1. ANC Mode (High Noise Cancellation): Blocks background ambient hums, engine noise, and chatter. Ideal for flights, trains, and office environments.

and chatter. Ideal for flights, trains, and office environments.
2. Transparency / Ambient Mode: Amplifies surrounding voices and traffic sounds using the external microphones so you can talk without removing the headphones.
3. Normal Mode (ANC Off): Disables noise cancellation circuitry to maximize battery lifespan up to 60 hours.

1. Pair the headphones with your first device (Device A) using standard Bluetooth pairing.
2. Disable Bluetooth on Device A to allow the headphones to re-enter pairing mode.
3. Turn on Bluetooth on your second device (Device B) and pair with "Lumina Wave ANC".
4. Re-enable Bluetooth on Device A. The headphones will now remain simultaneously connected to both Device A and Device B.

5. Audio will automatically pause on one device if an incoming voice call is received on the other.

- No sound from headphones: Ensure the headphones are turned ON, Bluetooth is paired, and the volume on both the headphones and the connected device is raised.
- Wired Mode operation: When using the 3.5mm audio cable, Bluetooth turns off automatically. ANC can still be turned ON in wired mode if battery power remains.

ANC can still be turned ON in wired mode if battery power remains.
- Hardware Reset: If the headphones freeze or fail to pair, connect the USB-C charging cable to a power source, then press and hold the Power button and Volume Down button simultaneously for 7 seconds. The status LED will flash purple 3 times, indicating memory reset.

1. Use only the provided magnetic USB charging dock included in the packaging box.
2. Align the two gold-plated magnetic charging pins on the charging dock with the corresponding charging contacts located on the rear casing of the watch.
3. The magnets will snap the dock securely into position.
4. Plug the USB-A end of the cable into a standard 5V/1A or 5V/2A certified wall adapter or a computer USB port.

5V/1A or 5V/2A certified wall adapter or a computer USB port.
5. The watch screen will illuminate and display the charging percentage. A full charge from 0% to 100% takes approximately 90 minutes.
6. Note: Do not use fast-charging power adapters exceeding 5V/2.4A as this may damage the internal battery regulator.

- The Lumina Fit Smart Watch has a water resistance rating of 5 ATM (50 meters). It is safe for recreational swimming in pools or shallow oceans, showering in cool water, and rain.
- Temperature Operating Range: -10°C to 45°C (14°F to 113°F).

- Temperature Operating Range: -10°C to 45°C (14°F to 113°F).
- STRICT WARNING - Sauna and Hot Water Restriction: Never wear the watch inside a sauna, steam room, hot tub, thermal spring, or hot shower. High temperatures cause the waterproof silicone gaskets to expand and degrade, allowing steam to penetrate the device.

to expand and degrade, allowing steam to penetrate the device.
- High-velocity water sports (such as waterskiing, jet-skiing, or deep scuba diving) exceed the 5 ATM pressure limit and are not supported.
- After swimming in chlorinated or salt water, always rinse the watch thoroughly with fresh tap water and dry it with a soft microfiber cloth.

- Daily Step and Calorie Tracking: Tracks daily physical movement automatically using internal motion sensors.
- Heart Rate Monitoring: Continuous 24/7 heart rate monitoring with customizable high/low heart rate alerts.
- Sleep Tracking: Automatically records deep sleep, light sleep, REM sleep, and awake periods between 8:00 PM and 10:00 AM.

sleep, REM sleep, and awake periods between 8:00 PM and 10:00 AM.
- Workout Modes: Supports over 30 sports activities including outdoor running, treadmill, pool swimming, cycling, and yoga.

- Screen Unresponsive: Press and hold the physical side button for 12 seconds to perform a hardware reboot.
- Bluetooth Sync Fails: Turn off Bluetooth on your smartphone, wait 10 seconds, turn it back on, and re-open the Lumina Health app.

wait 10 seconds, turn it back on, and re-open the Lumina Health app.
- Factory Reset: On the watch display, swipe down from the home screen, select "Settings" (gear icon) > "System" > "Factory Reset". This clears all on-device historical data and restores the watch to its original out-of-box state.

- Coverage Period: 1-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty covering hardware defects in materials and craftsmanship from the original date of purchase.
- Warranty Exclusions: Does not cover accidental drops, unauthorized disassembly or repair, cosmetic wear and tear, or liquid damage caused by steam, saunas, and hot water exceeding the 5 ATM water resistance limits.

1. Turn the power switch located on the bottom of the mouse to the "ON" position.
2. Slide the mode switch on the bottom of the mouse to the Bluetooth icon (BT mode).
3. Press and hold the circular "Connect" button for 3 seconds until the top LED indicator flashes blue rapidly. This indicates the mouse has entered pairing mode.
4. Open the Bluetooth settings on your laptop, tablet, or PC.

4. Open the Bluetooth settings on your laptop, tablet, or PC.
5. In the list of available devices, select "Lumina Silent Mouse".
6. The LED indicator will turn solid blue for 3 seconds and then turn off, confirming that pairing is complete.

1. Remove the magnetic battery cover on the underside of the mouse to access the USB nano receiver compartment.
2. Take out the USB nano receiver and plug it into an available USB-A port on your computer.
3. Slide the mode switch on the bottom of the mouse to the "2.4G" icon.
4. The LED indicator will glow solid green for 2 seconds. The mouse connects automatically without requiring additional driver installation.

- Rapid Blinking Blue: Mouse is in Bluetooth pairing mode searching for devices.
- Solid Blue (3 seconds): Bluetooth paired and connected successfully.
- Solid Green (2 seconds): 2.4GHz wireless receiver connected successfully.
- Blinking Red: Battery level is below 15%. Recharge immediately with the USB-C cable.
- Solid Red (while plugged in): Mouse battery is actively charging.

- Solid Red (while plugged in): Mouse battery is actively charging.
- Solid Green (while plugged in): Mouse battery is 100% fully charged.

- Mouse cursor does not move: Ensure the power switch is ON and battery is charged. Verify that the mode switch matches your connection method (BT or 2.4G).
- Bluetooth connection drops: Remove "Lumina Silent Mouse" from your computer's paired Bluetooth list, restart computer Bluetooth, and repeat the Bluetooth Pairing Instructions.

computer Bluetooth, and repeat the Bluetooth Pairing Instructions.
- Factory Reset Procedure: To clear all stored Bluetooth profiles and reset factory default DPI settings, hold down the Left Mouse Button, Right Mouse Button, and Scroll Wheel Click simultaneously for 5 seconds. The LED will blink white 3 times to confirm the reset.
